solution_review_scope.description: result-only means an independent LLM or checker can basically decide correctness by inspecting or replaying the submitted final answer or artifact against the frozen problem specification and declared reference data, without substantively reviewing a non-machine-checkable solution derivation. An ordinary written proof remains result-and-derivation; source-requested executable formal proof code may itself be the result. The rationale must also explain why the expected result genuinely answers the source question and any limits on that claim.
